notes: 32-bit game. eax = camera struct base at cameraWrite1Interceptor. Uses rotation MATRIX (4x4, not quaternion) starting at eax+0x00. Position at eax+0xA8 relative to outer struct. FOV at outer_struct+0x2A8. camera_write_profile disabled until rotation-matrix support is added.

intercepts.name: camera_write1
intercepts.description: Camera rotation matrix bulk write. eax = camera struct base (mov eax,ecx at entry). Copies 8x8-byte blocks (movq pairs) from ECX source to EAX dest. Intercept gives eax = camera base.

camera_write_profile._comment: DISABLED: FF13-2 uses a 4x4 rotation matrix, not quaternion. Rotation matrix starts at eax+0x00 (8x movq, 64 bytes). Position at parent_struct+0xA8. FOV at parent_struct+0x2A8. Enable after adding rotation_matrix support to camera_write_profile schema.
